scope: Reduced-model audit of saved body paths; no foothold replanning, dynamic forces, joint IK, RL, or robot execution.

primitives.greedy_reference: Recreates one selected contact per leg at each body node; changes are not assigned a gait.
primitives.fixed_heading_roll: Four unsteered wheels at yaw=0, level ground, pure x rolling; a y or z wheel-center displacement fails this narrow primitive.
primitives.locked_stance: Four previous contacts fixed in world, 21 interpolated body states, spherical leg reach, 1 cm static support margin, fixed-orientation body obstacle sweep.
